clusters.name: Rates curve/slope dynamics (curvature-gated)
clusters.assignment_rule: Curvature-gated slope-dynamics books on rates instruments
clusters.veto_rule: NEGATIVE_EXPECTANCY across all gate variants; declared executioner (LEVEL-vs-shape) did not out-earn — no gate-variant resurrection without a new executioner mechanism

clusters.name: Session-participation cycles (weekend/24h)
clusters.assignment_rule: Weekend liquidity participation cycles; 24h multi-cell matrices
clusters.veto_rule: ANCESTRY_RHO_BLOCK and matrix-wide expectancy kills stand; session-participation tweaks are rho-blocked against the OVN/session corpus

clusters.name: Frozen-rule venue transfer
clusters.assignment_rule: Bollinger+RSI frozen rule ported across altcoins
clusters.veto_rule: RULE_TRANSFER_FAILED: a frozen rule that failed once does not transfer by re-freeze; transfer = new mechanism claim

clusters.name: Data-probe / access-license blocks (no mechanism evidence)
clusters.assignment_rule: Source probes that never reached a scored family
clusters.veto_rule: NOT a mechanism death: cannot be cited as ancestry veto, but the access block stands until the source is legal

clusters.name: Mechanism-unknown free-cycle rows (ledger unrecoverable)

clusters.veto_rule: UNKNOWN_NOT_RECOVERABLE: treated as dead-by-denominator; any same-cycle-class revival must re-derive the mechanism from the frozen modules first
clusters.distinguishability_test: Recovery of the decisive per-arm reasons from frozen terminal artifacts

clusters.name: Exploratory/composite/policy legs
clusters.assignment_rule: Daily exploratory corpus legs; risk-policy composites over diagnostic legs
clusters.veto_rule: Incremental-alpha-negative and thin-aggregate kills stand; composites cannot rescue dead legs by aggregation

clusters.name: Session-open momentum/fade on city clocks (FX spot)
clusters.assignment_rule: Entry/state/trigger defined by a named city-session window (London open, late-NY, Tokyo-range, London-AM) on spot H1 bars; forced flat pre-rollover
clusters.veto_rule: No symbol/era/venue tweak of a city-session momentum/fade class without a mechanism the dead 7-pair spot H1 corpus could not represent (court §b: 1m trigger-time anatomy, trigger census, event-day conditioning, exit-horizon decomposition)

clusters.name: Macro/release-instant and release-window reaction classes (FX+crypto)
clusters.assignment_rule: Anchor = evidenced release instant or release-adjacent window (CPI/NFP/FOMC/BoJ prints, funding announcements, pre-release avoidance)
clusters.veto_rule: No re-parameterization of a release-reaction class whose expectancy/floor/concentration kills fired; new symbol/era needs its own PIT calendar + per-era anatomy pre-gate
clusters.distinguishability_test: PIT-verified calendar authority (not schedule-inference), minute-level anchors where claimed, per-era anatomy reproduction, declared surprise/vintage law

clusters.name: Carry / funding / basis (incl. settlement-funding positioning)
clusters.assignment_rule: Carry yield, funding level/jump, basis/premium level or term; funding-dodge positioning around settlements
clusters.veto_rule: No carry/basis variant without a funding/basis axis the dead corpus did not test and a cost-survival statement (carry classes died on expectancy and fold concentration)
clusters.distinguishability_test: Funding/basis axis PIT-evidenced; breakeven-horizon arithmetic pre-frozen; fold-concentration guard; nearest-window unfundability checked

clusters.name: Cross-sectional characteristic/factor books (stocks+crypto)
clusters.assignment_rule: Ranked characteristic portfolios (momentum, reversal, illiquidity, beta, accrual, filings, insider flow, OI/leverage, size)
clusters.veto_rule: No new characteristic book on the same substrate without incremental content vs the dead anchor family (CONTROL_REPRODUCED_MECHANISM and ILLIQ retest deaths are the bars)
clusters.distinguishability_test: Replication-retest discipline: dead anchors stay dead unless identity/execution remediation AND EXPECTANCY_NO_REPEAT-style non-reproduction is shown (SAMV1->RETEST precedent)

clusters.name: Volume/participation shock, order-flow continuation, settlement-cycle positioning
clusters.assignment_rule: Dollar-volume shock ratio, aggressor runs, OI collapse, attention phases, pre/post-settlement hedge pressure, lead-lag diffusion
clusters.veto_rule: Symbol/era tweaks of volume-shock continuation are pre-vetoed (XSECT-VOLSHK-S15 death; cited as ancestry W1 in HYPOTHESES_R2 §6)
clusters.distinguishability_test: Volume is classifier not traded signal (RMM standard); mechanism named at order-book actor level; NC clock-matched controls

clusters.name: Range-fade / band-edge / quote-state & microstructure-cost-gated intraday
clusters.assignment_rule: Prev-day band fades, displacement fades, spread/quote-state gates, fixing-window premia, fix rebalancing drift
clusters.veto_rule: No range-fade variant without a NEW conditioning axis (provenance/retest/spread-state were the dead variants; VARIANT_SAME_FAMILY kills stand); PIT seam and declared-band-vs-cost kills apply
clusters.distinguishability_test: Measurably distinct gate axis + declared cost band >= measured cost scale + PIT-clean quote/fixing provenance

clusters.name: Volatility/regime-state books and gates (ETP vol, vol-managed, breadth gates)
clusters.assignment_rule: Second-difference slope states, premium-state asymmetry, inverse-vol scaling, breadth eligibility gates
clusters.veto_rule: No standalone vol-regime book revival: cost ceilings and decay-path negatives killed the class; regime-conditioning must be overlay on a live host
clusters.distinguishability_test: Overlay H-G law compliance; era-aware cost law; decay-dominant-path negative expectancy stated a priori

clusters.name: Positioning/crowding (CFTC CoT)
clusters.assignment_rule: CoT crowd-carry persistence or positioning-extreme conditioning
clusters.veto_rule: Release-clock shadow falsification clause fired (COMMNG1: kills overdetermined); any CoT class must beat the release-clock shadow control
clusters.distinguishability_test: RELEASE_CLOCK_SHADOW control run; persistence beyond the release clock

clusters.name: Trend/breakout continuation (Donchian/phase/dead-band) + exit overlays
clusters.assignment_rule: Channel/Dow-phase breakout continuation, dead-band SMA trend, risk-exit overlays on trend books
clusters.veto_rule: Fold concentration and baseline-loss kills stand; overlays on dead books do not revive the book (BRV1/EOSV2 precedents)
